[SWS_DM_00864] Checking Supported Subfunction for CompareKey
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04005
⌈
The
Diagnostic Server instance
shall call
ara::diag::SecurityAc-
cess::CompareKey
when the requested subfunction value (
securityAc-
cessType
) - 1 (to get the corresponding requestSeed) is equal to the value of instance
of
DiagnosticSecurityAccess
with
requestSeedId
.
⌋
